data.name: Confettied
data.detailed_description:
100,000 pieces of confetti. Zero training. Welcome to your first day.

Your assignment? An office building that went way too hard celebrating Y2K. The music’s stopped. The new millennium has arrived. The place has been Confettied

With a staffing shortage and no time for proper training, you’re thrown straight into the job with only the most basic equipment. You'll Need to start by manually picking up confetti, one piece at a time...

RECYCLE & REINVEST

Turn the chaos into cold, hard company credits. Recycle your haul to fund your cleaning revolution. Along the way, you can unlock ventilation ducts to streamline your recycling drops and turn the tedious cleanup into a well-oiled operation.

UNCONVENTIONAL ARSENAL

Trade in your tweezers for high-powered, slightly questionable cleaning tech. Upgrade your tools and storage capacity to clean faster, reach farther, and suck harder.

MASTER THE OFFICE

Every room is a new challenge. Clearing a space unlocks new areas of the building, introducing fresh layouts, new obstacles, and even more confetti to conquer. Track your progress in real-time and don’t stop until the floor is spotless.

OFFICE DISTRACTIONS

When you need a break from the grind, explore, pop balloons, find hidden items, and master office mini-games to find elusive Gold Confetti to unlock new skins.

The office won't clean itself. 100,000 pieces of confetti await.

Chop C... ahem... I mean... vroom vroom!!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual Core
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
